title: collapsible tub
text: collapsible tub. Husband is diabetic and I needed easy to use tubs to soak feet.  This tub is perfect.  Use, clean, fold up and store under the sink.  Win/Win/Win.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: Prepworks by Progressive Collapsible Portable Wash Basin Dishpan
features: VERSATILE BASIN: The Collapsible Dish Tub is perfect for washing dishes, cleaning floors and more. It collapses to 1/3 its original height for compact storage. It's also great for camping or RV travel.
DISHWASHER SAFE: This portable, collapsible dish tub features raised feet that allow water to flow underneath, and its rigid design allows the tub to stand on its own for easy cleaning with no mess.

MANY USES: Take it camping to use as a dish tub, use it as a drink carrier at your tailgate party, or use it for cleaning supply storage. With a 9.25 quart capacity & a collapsible design, it's a must-have!

STYLISH DESIGN & SOLID FUNCTIONALITY: Our philosophy is simple: offer stylish designs with no-nonsense functionality. We understand the kitchen is the heart of the home, where family & friends connect.
INNOVATING KITCHEN ESSENTIALS: We boast over 40 years of innovating kitchen products & housewares with unique gadgets & tools for food preparation plus thoughtfully designed food storage containers.
description: The Collapsible Dish Tub is a versatile tool for all your household tasks. The Large 9.5 Quart Capacity is great for washing dishes, cleaning floors and more. Take it camping to use as a dish tub or to hold all those delicious ingredients for s’mores. Also features raised feet to allow water to flow underneath. The rigid design allows the tub to stand on its own and best of all, it easily collapses to ⅓ its original height for compact storage. This dish tub is Dishwasher Safe for easy, convenient cleaning. Patented.
